note: A synthetic policy. Each item is the body of POST /api/v1/policy/{section}/items without expected_version; "proposed": true marks an item an agent token would add and the owner has not confirmed yet.

decision.label: Target roles
decision.statement: Shortlist data, backend and platform engineering roles at mid to senior level.

decision.label: Locations
decision.statement: Dismiss roles that need me on site outside these places.

decision.label: Languages outside my list
decision.statement: Dismiss postings that require a language outside my list, as soon as they are collected.

decision.label: Postings no longer listed
decision.statement: Dismiss jobs to review when their source stops listing them.

decision.label: No reply
decision.statement: Close an application as "no reply" when the employer has not answered in this time.

eligibility.label: Work authorization
eligibility.statement: EU citizen with a Swiss B permit.
eligibility.note: The date is the end of the permit.

eligibility.label: Relocation
eligibility.statement: No relocation outside Switzerland. Remote work for a company abroad is fine.

writing.label: Weaknesses
writing.statement: Never volunteer weaknesses or missing skills.

writing.label: Letter length
writing.statement: Three paragraphs, under 200 words. One concrete result per paragraph.

writing.label: One page
writing.statement: The CV fits one page. Drop the oldest experience first.

writing.label: Spelling
writing.statement: British spelling. Plain words; no "passionate", no "leverage".

facts.label: Notice period
facts.statement: One month to the end of a month.

facts.label: Salary, Germany
facts.statement: Expected salary for roles paid in Germany.
